test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?

28, 31, 36, 43, 54, ?
solution:
The logic followed here is,

The differences between consecutive terms are 3, 5, 7, 11, which are prime numbers in increasing order.

The next prime number after 11 is 13.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/940f3cdb8aa0f4797198fb0eec5ccc0c0a6e08c0b31ece05bb7020e047b86790.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14cf55a10157c13253f920cc29bd12576cac33baee0143fc0530f2bb4cd74734.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
